A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how to integrate organizational knowledge in the process mining workflow.
we have developed a process mining framework that is able to extract process models out of event log data, and to improve the quality of the process model by integrating additional information.
we have developed an innovative process mining approach to support the process of process improvement.

it is possible to use process mining to improve the quality of process models.
